description: Aloe rust is a fungal infection characterized by small, elevated brownish or blackish pustules that develop on the leaf surface.
symptoms: Small circular yellow or pale green spots turning into dark brown or black pustules
Raised blisters or spots on both upper and lower leaf surfaces
Surrounding tissue may show localized yellowing or chlorosis

sanitation.step: Prune and dispose of severely infected leaves using clean, sanitized cutting tools to reduce fungal spore load.
sources: General Plant Pathology Principles (Agrios, Plant Pathology 5th Ed)

sanitation.step: Disinfect tools with 70% isopropyl alcohol between cuts to avoid transmitting spores between plants.

cultural.step: Avoid overhead watering; irrigate strictly at the soil base to keep foliage completely dry.
Improve spacing between plants to enhance ventilation and accelerate surface moisture drying.
